message: The other day, I found myself in our family group chat, and it was a flurry of messages about our emergency go-bags. My daughter was asking if I had enough water in mine, while my son was busy sending links to checklists. It made me realize how much easier it is to stay prepared when we all share the responsibility, even if it is just over texts! 😊 It feels good knowing we’re all in this together, doesn’t it? What do you think is the most important thing to have in your go-bag?
